name: PowOS device agent
description: This device's card, live status and actions for the Devices app on the other PowOS devices (lib/devices/powos-deviced; docs/DEVICES.md). HTTPS :3416 on the LAN/VPN with its own pinned certificate; every status/action call needs a per-device token given at pairing or enrollment. On the phone the backend reaches Android through the session's adb to itself (rooted; the non-root app serves the same protocol itself). Unit: units/phone/powos-deviced.json.
